entry.name: amxd~
entry.description: Use the amxd~ object to load a Max for Live device and use it in MSP. When the amxd~ object is instantiated as mcs.amxd~ its audio inputs combined into a single multichannel input and its audio outputs are combined into a single multichannel output.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.digest: Load a Max for Live device via drag & drop
messages.description: Drag a Max for Live .amxd file from the patcher window sidebar or the Finder/Explorer onto anobject to load the Max for Live device into the object.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Load a Max for Live device from the patcher window sidebar
messages.description: Click and drag a Max for Live .amxd file from the patcher window sidebar to create anobject containing the Max for Live device.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Control Parameter values with a message consisting of the parameter name and the value e.g.: "Gain -6"

messages.name: drag_replace
messages.digest: Drag a Max for Live device onto the object to replace
messages.description: In an unlocked patch, drag any Max for Live device onto the amxd~ object to replace the loaded device.

messages.name: getinfo
messages.description: Get info about a specific parameter out of the 4th outlet.

messages.name: getparams
messages.description: Get a list of all available parameters out of the 4th outlet.

messages.name: getvalue
messages.description: Get the value of a specific parameter out of the 4th outlet.

messages.name: midievent
messages.digest: Send a MIDI event to the Max for Live device
messages.description: The word, followed by two to four numbers, sends a MIDI event to the Max for Live device. The first three number arguments are the bytes of the MIDI message. The fourth, optional, argument is a detune parameter used for MIDI note messages. The value ranges from -63 to 64 cents, with 0 being the default.

messages.name: midiin
messages.digest: Send MIDI messages to the Max for Live device
messages.description: In the third inlet, send MIDI messages to the Max for Live device.

messages.name: open
messages.digest: Open the Max for Live device window
messages.description: Themessage with no arguments opens a floating window for the Max for Live device. If the window was previously opened, then the edit window location will be brought to the front.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Input to be processed by the Max for Live device
messages.description: Input to be processed by the Max for Live device. If the device is an instrument plug-in, the input will be ignored.

inlets.description: MIDI input to the Max for Live device (byte-by-byte).

outlets.description: Out left outlet: Audio output from the Max for Live device. The left outlet is the left channel (or channel 1).
Out middle outlet: Audio output from the Max for Live device. The middle outlet is the right channel (or channel 2).
Out right outlet: MIDI output from the Max for Live device (byte-by-byte).
